topics.name: Integers and exponents
misconceptions: Thinking that −3 squared is the same as (−3) squared.
Multiplying two negatives and getting a negative.
Thinking a larger exponent always gives a larger number.

topics.name: Rational and irrational numbers
misconceptions: Thinking every decimal is irrational.
Believing recurring decimals cannot be written as fractions.
Thinking the square root of two can be written exactly as a fraction.

topics.name: Algebraic expressions
misconceptions: Thinking 2a + 3b equals 5ab.
Multiplying only the first term inside a bracket.
Confusing a coefficient with an exponent.

topics.name: Expanding and factorising
misconceptions: Multiplying only the first terms of two binomials.
Getting signs wrong in difference of two squares.
Taking out only part of the common factor.

topics.name: Linear equations and inequalities
misconceptions: Not doing the same operation to both sides of an equation.
Forgetting to flip the inequality sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative number.
Leaving brackets unresolved.

topics.name: Number patterns and sequences
misconceptions: Thinking the first difference is the rule for every kind of pattern.
Confusing the term number with the term value.

topics.name: Ratio, rate and proportion
misconceptions: Confusing a ratio with a fraction.
Adding instead of multiplying when working with proportion.
Thinking direct proportion simply means 'both get bigger'.

topics.name: Financial mathematics
misconceptions: Confusing simple interest with compound interest.
Using the wrong percentage.
Forgetting to change months into years.

topics.name: Functions and graphs
misconceptions: Thinking the gradient is only the vertical change.
Confusing the x-intercept with the y-intercept.
Assuming every graph is a straight line.

topics.name: Lines, angles and triangles
misconceptions: Thinking alternate angles are equal when the lines are not parallel.
Confusing congruent triangles with similar triangles.
Thinking a longer side always means a bigger angle.

topics.name: Theorem of Pythagoras
misconceptions: Adding the squares instead of taking the square root to find the hypotenuse.
Using the theorem on triangles that are not right-angled.
Mixing up the hypotenuse with a shorter side.

topics.name: Surface area and volume
misconceptions: Confusing surface area with volume.
Using the wrong formula for a cylinder.
Writing volume in square units instead of cubic units.

topics.name: Mean, median and mode
misconceptions: Thinking the mean must be one of the data values.
Finding the median without first ordering the data.
Assuming every data set has a mode.

topics.name: Probability
misconceptions: Thinking a probability can be greater than 1 or less than 0.
Confusing experimental probability with theoretical probability.
Thinking a coin is 'due' to land heads after several tails.
